items.source:
Such an event publication step is effectively a hand-off to the
multicaster and does not imply synchronous/asynchronous execution
or even immediate execution at all. Event listeners are encouraged
to be as efficient as possible, individually using asynchronous
execution for longer-running and potentially blocking operations.
items.translation: 此类事件发布步骤实质上是将控制权移交给多播器，并不暗示同步/异步执行，甚至不意味着立即执行。鼓励事件监听器尽可能高效，对于耗时较长且可能阻塞的操作，应单独使用异步执行。

items.source: If the specified event is not an ApplicationEvent, it is wrapped in a PayloadApplicationEvent.
items.translation: 如果指定的 `event`》不是ApplicationEvent，则将其包装在PayloadApplicationEvent中。

items.source: Serves as a super-interface for ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 充当ApplicationContext的超级接口。

items.source: For the convenient inclusion of the current transaction context in a reactive hand-off, consider using TransactionalEventPublisher.publishEvent(java.util.function.Function). For thread-bound transactions, this is not necessary since the state will be implicitly available through thread-local storage.
items.translation: 为了方便在响应式交接中包含当前事务上下文，请考虑使用TransactionalEventPublisher.publishEvent(java.util.function.Function)。对于线程绑定的事务，这是不必要的，因为状态将通过线程本地存储隐式可用。

items.source: For the convenient inclusion of the current transaction context in a reactive hand-off, consider using TransactionalEventPublisher.publishEvent(Object). For thread-bound transactions, this is not necessary since the state will be implicitly available through thread-local storage.
items.translation: 为了方便在响应式交接中包含当前事务上下文，请考虑使用TransactionalEventPublisher.publishEvent(Object)。对于线程绑定的事务，这是不必要的，因为状态将通过线程本地存储隐式可用。

items.source: For usage in a reactive call stack, include event publication as a simple hand-off: Mono.fromRunnable(() -> eventPublisher.publishEvent(...)). As with any asynchronous execution, thread-local data is not going to be available for reactive listener methods. All state which is necessary to process the event needs to be included in the event instance itself.
items.translation: 在反应式调用栈中使用事件发布时，请将其作为简单的交接处理： Mono.fromRunnable(() -> eventPublisher.publishEvent(...))。 与任何异步执行一样，线程本地数据对于反应式监听器方法将不可用。所有处理事件所需的必要状态都必须包含在事件实例本身中。

items.source: Notify all matching listeners registered with this application of an event.
items.translation: 通知此应用程序注册的所有匹配的监听器以响应事件。

items.source: Notify all matching listeners registered with this application of an application event.
items.translation: 通知所有与此应用程序注册的匹配监听器以响应应用程序事件。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
